item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are in public preview. They let workloads sharing a task hub use named queues so you can separate throughput needs and downstream service limits.

  • Source: Azure Updates
